title: Remove auth wall from public shared team views
rationale: Middleware and /s/[id] page use Clerk but no hard auth block on viewing found. Ticket says 'may be' behind auth — work is: audit actual Clerk protection on /s/[id], ensure anonymous access is fully unblocked, add guest 'Fork this team' bottom banner (show to unauthenticated users). Note: ticket itself says 'product decision needed before implementation' — should confirm with owner before starting.

title: Downloadable "team card" image — Spotify Wrapped-style shareable artifact
rationale: /api/team-graphic route (266 lines, next/og ImageResponse) already renders a team card PNG server-side. html2canvas-pro is in package.json. Work is: wire a 'Save as image' button in ShareDock that calls /api/team-graphic?id=X&style=wide and triggers a download, plus optionally a Story (1080x1920) variant in the existing route.

title: Growth: Embeddable team report widget for forums and blogs
rationale: /embed/[id]/page.tsx (94 lines) already exists. /api/oembed/route.ts (46 lines) already exists. Work is: expose a copy-able embed snippet (iframe HTML) in ShareDock, add oEmbed meta tag to /s/[id] head, and optionally style the embed page for minimal chrome. Infrastructure is already in place.

title: VGC match tracker — log results vs archetypes, win-rate dashboard
rationale: No match_logs table in DB yet — needs schema migration + API route + dashboard UI. Feasible in 4hr for an MVP: DB table, POST /api/match-log route, simple dashboard component with win-rate aggregation. No external dependencies.

title: Pre-built Champions sample teams (3-5 archetypes)
rationale: Champions page and Pokedex exist. Work is: author 3-5 Showdown paste strings for canonical archetypes (Mega Kangaskhan goodstuffs, Primal Groudon sun, Primal Kyogre rain, Mega Salamence, Mega Metagross), seed them as hardcoded sample data in ChampionsContent.tsx with a 'Try this team' CTA that pre-fills the builder. No external API needed.

title: Champions meta snapshot page
rationale: Explore page + Champions page already exist. Work is: add a DB query aggregating most-used Pokemon/Megas/items/archetypes from published Champions-format reports, create /champions/meta page with usage chart component. Relies on existing is_public + format fields in DB. No external deps.

title: SEO: Target high-volume VGC search terms with landing pages
rationale: Static Next.js pages are cheap to add. Work is: create 3-5 targeted landing pages (e.g. /vgc-team-builder, /vgc-speed-tiers, /champions-vgc-teams) with targeted H1/meta/content and internal links to the main tool. R6 SEO audit already identified the key terms. No external deps.

title: Retention: Browser push notifications via service worker
rationale: Notifications table already exists in DB. notifications.ts lib exists. Work is: add web-push subscription endpoint, store push subscriptions in DB, trigger push from existing notification creation flow, add 'Enable notifications' opt-in UI. Requires web-push npm package (free). VGC-127 (real-time in-app notifications) is higher priority and should be done first if both are tackled.

title: Ops: Add POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY for error tracking cron
rationale: Code already supports POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY (falls back to POSTHOG_API_KEY). The cron route at /api/cron/posthog-errors and /api/webhooks/posthog both reference it. Work is only: generate key in PostHog dashboard, add to .env.local and Vercel env vars. No code changes needed — purely an ops/config task. Blocked on human action (PostHog UI access).

title: Inline damage calculator on Pokemon detail slides
rationale: @smogon/calc is NOT installed (not in node_modules or package.json). Requires npm install @smogon/calc (~1.5MB), then build a PokemonCalcPanel component wired into the detail slide. The @smogon/calc library is open-source (MIT) and free. This is a borderline 4hr task given the new dependency integration, but achievable in a focused session.
